title: Materialise Urges Coordinated AM Network for Defense
summary: Materialise called for shared standards, qualification frameworks, and secure digital infrastructure to link production resources across borders.

title: Italian Startup GR1T Unveils Modular Electric Motorcycle
summary: Startup GR1T introduced a single platform serving as the foundation for four distinct electric motorcycles sharing the same components.

title: Simulating Plasma Chambers for Semiconductor Manufacturing
summary: Researchers linked plasma chamber simulation with feature-scale process modeling to optimize plasma etching processes and predict etch profiles.

title: Detachable Fiber Connectors Create Photonics Challenges
summary: Multiple designs are emerging for CPO and NPO, though standardization and high-volume manufacturing remain unready.

title: AMD Completes Acquisition of AI Chip Pioneer Taalas
summary: The deal adds specialized silicon expertise to AMD's accelerator roadmap and expands its engineering presence in Canada.

title: BAE Systems Develops Passive Ghost Radar
summary: BAE Systems developed a portable stealth system that detects and tracks airborne threats without transmitting radio signals.

title: New Guide for NEC4 Engineering Contracts
summary: A new book provides practical solutions and step-by-step guidance for professionals administering NEC4 engineering and construction contracts.

title: Flexell Space and ALATYR Partner on Orbital Solar Power
summary: Flexell Space and ALATYR signed an MoU to assess ultralight solar cells for space-based computing infrastructure.

title: Luminary Autopilot Automates Physics AI Workflows
summary: Luminary Autopilot introduces prompts to create AI simulation workflows supported by continual large physics models.

title: Snomo Electric Touring Skis
summary: Snomo has developed a set of cross-country touring skis featuring built-in electric motors to assist users in snowy environments.

title: Grana Vision-Language Model for Robot Manipulation
summary: Researchers introduced Grana, a compositional reward model that estimates continuous progress for long-horizon robot tasks.

title: AMISS Integrity Framework for Magnetic Navigation
summary: A solution-separation monitoring algorithm was developed to detect map errors and bound estimation errors in magnetic navigation.

title: Teleoperated Robotic Haircutting with Delay Compensation
summary: A unilateral Internet teleoperation framework combines delay-compensation techniques and passivity-based control for robotic haircutting.

title: Evaluating Local AI Agents in Power Electronics Simulation
summary: A new evaluation framework measures the power, energy, and time costs of running local agentic AI for power electronics simulations.

title: Multi-Agent Self-Play for Autonomous Driving Scenarios
summary: An extended multi-agent self-play framework uses agent-relative dynamic goals to generate safety-critical edge cases for autonomous vehicle testing.

title: Allocentric Belief Enables Communication-Free Collective Intelligence
summary: Researchers show that anchoring decentralized agents to a single shared external witness allows spontaneous, communication-free coordination across multiple environments.

title: Probing Action-Dependent Semantic Forecasting in Autonomous Driving
summary: A study evaluates action dependence in autonomous driving world models, showing that wrong actions severely degrade semantic forecasting performance.

title: Greedy Vector Approximation for Multiplierless Complex Products
summary: A new greedy approximation algorithm improves complex-valued inner products in multiplierless hardware for fast Fourier transform twiddle factors.

title: Synthesizing Hyperspectral Data for Low-Cost Crop Residue Mapping
summary: A novel decoupling framework uses conditional generative models to augment sparse ground-truth datasets for hyperspectral unmixing.

title: RoboMorpher Scales Robot Morphology for Cross-Embodiment Actions
summary: RoboMorpher introduces a morphology-conditioned action tokenizer that associates control coordinates with kinematic effects across diverse robots.

title: LAaDT-DSS: Decision Support Software for Rooftop PV Systems
summary: LAaDT-DSS provides non-experts with simulation-based decision support for rooftop photovoltaic investments under Turkish tariff rules.

title: HINT-WAM: Hindsight-Informed Training for World Action Models
summary: HINT-WAM introduces an on-policy self-distillation framework that supervises robot action experts using hindsight video as privileged information.

title: Hierarchical Traffic Engineering for Satellite Networks
summary: A hierarchical software-defined networking framework coordinates constellation and payload levels to reduce congestion and improve throughput in satellite networks.

title: Hierarchical Admittance-Impedance Control for Mobile Manipulators
summary: A new hierarchical controller combines Cartesian impedance and admittance supervision to enable safe human-guided mobile manipulator load transfers.

title: Transferability of Lateral Velocity Estimation on Production Vehicles
summary: Researchers demonstrate that input selection and physical data augmentations improve the cross-vehicle transferability of neural-network lateral velocity estimators.

title: NASA Pairs SkyFall Helicopters With Nuclear Rocket
summary: Experts question NASA's mission architecture as the agency plans to transport SkyFall Mars helicopters using its first nuclear rocket.

title: Sparse Signal-Multiplexing Network Ranging Framework Proposed
summary: Researchers proposed a task-oriented network ranging framework that uses joint graph and schedule design to reduce rounds and improve localization accuracy.

title: Frequency Spreading Codes for FRESH Filtering Interference Cancellation
summary: A new frequency spreading code approach controls spectral correlation properties at low redundancy factors to enable co-channel interference cancellation.

title: Tesla Invites Buyers for Cybercab
summary: Tesla has invited a small number of customers to purchase its steering-wheel-less, pedal-less self-driving Cybercab.

title: Single-Chip Multiturn Position Sensors
summary: Advanced magnetic sensing technology enables accurate tracking of rotational movement in actuators even when power is removed.
